source.scope: Complete kernel/susfs source directory, including original licenses

integration.loader: Reuse XKCNSU ksuinit::load_module_with_resolver; no ksuinit replacement

local_adaptations: Acquire XKCNSU root API v1 with symbol_get and retain its provider until dependent hooks are removed
Require prepare_unload before delete_module; retain failed restorations resident
Serialize supercall control work against teardown and verify restored table writes
Share the root AVC feature when API extension callbacks are available; never install duplicate shared probes
Block AVC for unknown or incompatible KPM engines; the isolated XKCNSU engine can coexist
Use strict userspace KMI, import resolution, provider identity and operation readback
Preserve native mkdirat EEXIST results for root, dot and dot-dot paths
Use AArch32 EABI mkdirat/mknodat/linkat/symlinkat syscall numbers

coordinator_contract.ordering: Root ready, then SUSFS. Derive conflict from one KPM probe: error or active without the full managed capabilities. Recheck after guard load. The root feature also checks BTF and rejects inline trampolines.
coordinator_contract.unload: Write 1 to parameters/prepare_unload, verify readiness and zero restore error, then delete_module without force.
